GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 7th 6 Lengths 1200m 7th over-racing 6 Lengths 800m 7th 6 Lengths 600m Hooked Out Four Wide home turn 4th widest runner Straight ran on hard final 100m to win # back/strong win
Jumped Well , Settled Down Two Wide 4th, 3 Lengths @ 900m. fanned 3 Wide Straightening Up all Clear . Never Stopped Trying into busy finish # good trail/sound
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Debut for stable. Jumped fairly. Worked fwd 3 Wide & raced 3rd 3 Wide No Cover (1L from lead) early . Worked to hold ground midrace & pushed to quicken =lead Five Wide on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & boxed on well in last 150m until shaded late. # Wide/tried hard.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout. Passing the 25m was bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 3rd Inside 2 Lengths Couldn'T Go On @ 400m, # struggled
(ex Peter Sinclair) Jumped ok Caught Wide out of Straight & settling down 4 Lengths (1600m), no cover midrace & out 5 deep cornering, held Ground before tiring # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide without cover from the 1100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 5 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted out around heels Straightening Up and ran on hitting Lead at the 220m, went clear and kept going to post. # solid win
Jumped Ok settled 3l off, eased 3 Wide turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, running on 1 length off 200m, took over passing 100m and drew clear, # had run/too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide, without cover, throughout the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to 3 Wide joint Lead settling down, in Two Wide by the 1000m, held together much same to turn Two Wide trailing a half length, kept battling in straight. (Blinkers OFF FIRST TIME) # battled on ok

Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.75 Lengths Two Wide , Held Together same middle stages then moved up to Two Wide joint Lead at the 600m, drew clear and led Two Wide by 1 length turning, kept going in Straight and only Headed 50m from post. [Stewards: Travelled keenly early/middle stages.] # battled on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled keenly in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out then hampered, missed start 2 Lengths and Settled Down 4 Lengths on fence, railed to 3 Lengths turning, moved to 3rd place improving a length on its stablemate which finished 2nd. [Stewards: Travelled keenly early/middle stages.] # slow start no help
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin and hampered shortly after, losing ground (2L). Travelled keenly in the early and middle stages.
